description: Switches and status for the Bank Balances dashboard widget. Credentials, environment and bank links are NOT here: they live in the native ERPNext Plaid Settings and on each Bank record, and this widget reads those.

fields.description: Master switch for the Bank Balances widget on the Finance dashboard. Credentials (client id / secret), the environment, and the bank links themselves live in the native Plaid Settings (ERPNext Integrations) and on each Bank record; this widget only reads the balances of banks linked there.
fields.label: Show the Bank Balances widget

fields.description: Optional. Company these accounts belong to (for labelling).
fields.label: Company

fields.description: How often (minutes) the scheduled job may refresh balances. Balances change slowly, so ~240 (4h) keeps Plaid calls low.
fields.label: Refresh Throttle (Minutes)

fields.description: Set when Plaid reports a non-retryable error (e.g. login required, bad keys). While set, the scheduler stops refreshing so a dead connection can't storm the API. Cleared automatically when you edit credentials or reconnect successfully.
fields.label: Auth Blocked (Paused)
